title: Dittmer MO standings
author: Jason Gillman
event_desc: a 12-player tournament in Dittmer, Missouri, known only from a posted standings list
summary: Jason Gillman posted the standings of a 12-player tournament in Dittmer, Missouri, which he won ahead of Tony Nowicki and Justin Gillman.
notes: The post is only a standings list: '12 players' and places 1st to 12th (names in lower case in the post, capitalised here). No date, store, games or decks.
The posted title is a private street address in Dittmer, Missouri; it is not shown (title_display 'Dittmer MO standings', withhold_title true). Only the town is used.

Event date not stated; event_date null. Named after the posting month (20 March 2002): 'March 2002 Dittmer tournament'; the event may be earlier. No Dittmer or matching Missouri event on [[List of SWCCG tournaments]].
Format Premiere - Theed Palace by the posting date (no cards named, so not a virtual-card format); uncertain because the date is not stated.

Jason Gillman (byline 'Jason "3RD EYE" Gillman') linked to his existing page. Every other name is new; Justin Gillman, the Nowickis and the Chastanes share surnames but the post does not say how they are related.
event_date 2002-03 is the posting month (20 March 2002); the report gives no date.
redaction_note: the posted title, a private street address, is not shown; the standings list itself is complete; the archive link points to the DeckTech report index because the report's own address contains the street address
